My career journey has equipped me with advanced technical skills, from process modeling and data analysis to metallurgical accounting and energy balance formulation. I am passionate about fostering team growth, driving continuous improvement, and delivering shareholder value. My goal is to combine technical innovation and operational excellence to achieve sustainable success.
